# Connection

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Connection`](gmeow-Connection.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Connection>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/connectivity`](../../slices/connectivity.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reified traversable link between two entities, able to bear its own period, cost, weight, bandwidth, confidence, and standpoint. The flat shortcut is [`gmeow:connectsTo`](../properties/gmeow-connectsTo.md); promote to [`Connection`](gmeow-Connection.md) when metadata matters.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Connection`](gmeow-Connection.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Transit Route

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/connectivity/examples/transit-route.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/connectivity/examples/transit-route.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-connectivity-examples-transit-route)#example-slices-extensions-connectivity-examples-transit-route

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: connectivity is one graph machinery for every domain. A
# gmeow:Route runs from gmeow:routeStart through gmeow:routeVia stops to
# gmeow:routeEnd, tagged with a gmeow:routeKind — and that kind is an open
# vocabulary spanning transit, walking, flight, citation, dependency and social
# routes. So the SAME Route/Connection model describes a subway line, a paper's
# citation chain, and a package's dependency path. A gmeow:Connection is the
# single edge (source → target) the routes are built from.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/connectivity/> .

# --- A single edge of the network: the Central→Midtown hop.
ex:hop a gmeow:Connection ;
    gmeow:connectionSource ex:central ;
    gmeow:connectionTarget ex:midtown .
```
